## Linked issue

Closes #

## Rationale and scope

Describe the problem being solved, why this approach is proportionate, and what is intentionally out of scope.

## Validation and evidence

List the checks actually run and the evidence observed. Include failures or environment limitations rather than implying they passed.

For a visual/browser-facing change, commit representative screenshots under `evidence/` and embed them below using GitHub raw URLs pinned to this PR branch or commit, so reviewers can inspect them before merge. State the viewport, scenario, and any simulation or other limitations. Keep automated artifact upload as additional evidence, not the only review path.

## Risks and gaps

Call out behavioural, compatibility, safety, governance or enforcement risks, plus anything that still needs human authority.

## Reviewer notes

Identify the most important assumptions or files for an independent reviewer to challenge. Do not treat author self-review as independent approval.
